headline.text: L2 VFFS down *2 hours* on web tracking fault at window close — Syntegon support engaged but no resolution yet

per_plant_summary.L1: S1 ran changeover from crunch to variety pack and started depositing at 08:18. S3 hit metal contamination twice in pecan lot — switched lots mid-shift and monitoring. S4 ran Bequet caramel all shift.
per_plant_summary.L2: VFFS completed milk caramel run and started 15.5oz variety pack changeover at 16:09, fought sealing issues through 2nd shift, then went down at 09:24 on web tracking controller conflict — still down at 11:01 waiting on Syntegon remote support. ML2 and ML3 ran clean.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 depositor had hopper clog and Cavanna sensor jams — both cleared by 2nd shift. Truffle line down all 3rd shift repairing broken enrober wire mesh, back up at 07:06. ML4 fought mold jams all night, replaced bent cooler rails, slowed to 25 MPM — reject system still bypassing bad bars to packaging, manual trigger workaround in place.

resolved.title: VFFS sealing issues after changeover to 15.5oz variety pack
resolved.summary: Open bags and poor seals after line clearance and changeover from milk caramel zero sugar.
resolved.resolution: Running by 19:56 after multiple stops for adjustments and refresh cycles — improvement seen, stable by end of 2nd shift.

resolved.title: VFFS bags folding improperly at 07:09
resolved.summary: Bags coming out with folded edge; affected product removed and reworked.
resolved.resolution: Line running at 07:30 after maintenance adjustments.

resolved.title: Truffle enrober wire mesh broken during reheat
resolved.summary: Excessive chocolate buildup without mesh running caused breakage; multiple tears found and repaired overnight.
resolved.resolution: Wire mesh repaired by 04:47, enrober error cleared, temper achieved, depositing at 07:06.

resolved.title: ML1 nozzle clog at 01:36
resolved.summary: Followed flowchart, cleaned dosing head and nozzles, passed ATP, reassembled and filled hopper.
resolved.resolution: Line running normally by 04:11 — "Line is running normally" (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 hopper clog on right depositor side
resolved.summary: Clog cleared after draining hopper and finding stirrer hitting wall; adjusted and clog eliminated by 17:00.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:00 — "We have got rid of the clog" and stirrer no longer hitting wall per Tyson at 17:16.

resolved.title: ML4 sticker applicator belt worn and shredding
resolved.summary: Belt shifting into motor block, shaft and bearings worn out; slowed line to 10 MPM and applied stickers by hand.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced and working properly by 10:21 (1st shift).

resolved.title: ML1 Cavanna jamming on infeed and transfer belts
resolved.summary: Product jams between c7 & c8 belt and infeed; sensors B150, B140, B141, WB150s adjusted for sensitivity.
resolved.resolution: Running well at 08:23 after maintenance adjusted sensors and cleaned excess chocolate from chain teeth.

resolved.title: MF Matrix cone weld cracking
resolved.summary: Weld on cone cracking with potential for metal particle contamination if pieces break off.
resolved.resolution: Cone replaced by maintenance; no broken pieces found in area (Angel Cabrera at 20:43).

resolved.title: ML1 cooling cabinet temperature fluctuating 58.8F to 53.4F
resolved.summary: Chocolate not demolding; cooler temp unstable causing poor release from molds.
resolved.resolution: Running normal at 05:26 — maintenance reset HMI and checked fan (Raoul).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 2 temper out of range at shift start
resolved.summary: Multiple adjustments needed to bring depositor 2 chocolate temper into acceptable range.
resolved.resolution: In range by 06:48 after operator adjustments.

resolved.title: Truffle M3 belt drifting
resolved.summary: Belt moving out of position on truffle flow-wrap line.

needs_attention.title: S3 metallic contamination in pecan lot 26635-N
needs_attention.summary: Two magnetic metal fragments (slag from stick welding) found embedded in chocolate pieces within 2 hours; X-ray caught both, metal detector did not.
needs_attention.status: Switched to pecan lot 26632-N at 10:54. Monitoring for third hit (3 in 8 hours = line shutdown and full investigation). Alternate lot staged and ready.

needs_attention.title: S1 metal debris found under blue incline after Eaglestone work
needs_attention.summary: Metal found on floor under blue belt after technicians finished work on belt sides; area had been cleaned and inspected.
needs_attention.status: Sticky roller used to clean floor. Line running but metal source unclear; rollers were not removed during work.

needs_attention.title: VFFS down on web tracking and HMI conflict
needs_attention.summary: Both web tracking and HMI active simultaneously when only one should be enabled; controller fault preventing operation.
needs_attention.status: Down since 09:24. Dave on hold with US Support, Ray reached out to Syntegon (Larry), still waiting at 10:48 window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 reject system bypassing unfilled bars to packaging
needs_attention.summary: Photo eye before reject not triggered long enough when bars are spaced; system fails to kick bad bars especially in larger groups.
needs_attention.status: Manual trigger workaround in place — operator stationed at de-mold to manually activate reject when WDS light shows. TG support requested overnight; awaiting programming fix.

needs_attention.title: ML4 mold jams at cooler 1 and mold exchange
needs_attention.summary: Recurring jams at cooling cabinet entrance/exit and reject lifter; bent rails replaced overnight, line slowed to 25 MPM.
needs_attention.status: Running at 25 MPM as of 04:05 after replacing bent cooler rails. Reject lifter flipped and adjusted; monitoring for further jams.

needs_attention.title: ML4 buffer tank 1 not auto-filling from PTL
needs_attention.summary: Operators manually filling buffer 1; auto transfer from post-temper loop not functioning.
needs_attention.status: Still filling manually at shift end 11:01. Chris Givens to investigate root cause 1st shift.
